sloka: सा तेन कपिमुख्येन विमुक्ता महती शिला ।बिभेद बहुधा घोरा प्रहस्तस्य शिरस्तदा ।। ६.५८.५४ ।।।।
transliteration: sā tena kapimukhyena vimuktā mahatī śilā ।bibheda bahudhā ghorā prahastasya śirastadā ।। 6.58.54 ।।।।

translations.english: Fighting with the mallet, Neela quickly dropped the rock on that Prahastha's forehead
